Title: Azure Cognitive Services—Neural Text to Speech has new voice styles

Body.Content:
Neural Text to Speech now has new voice styles—newscast, customer service, and digital assistant. Tailor the voice of your apps and services to fit your unique scenario using these new styles, and customize your voice to express different emotions - like cheerfulness or empathy - to fit the context. The new voice styles are available for our English and Chinese neural TTS voices. 

Learn more and read our documentation to get started creating a dynamic voice for your brand.
